name: TechBBQ 2021
description:
TechBBQ is back and bringing you the biggest tech and innovation summit in Scandinavia! We're gathering the Nordic startup community and building bridges with the investment and corporate worlds. 

📣 𝙎𝙝𝙖𝙧𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙠𝙣𝙤𝙬𝙡𝙚𝙙𝙜𝙚 𝙞𝙨 #𝙩𝙝𝙚𝙣𝙤𝙧𝙙𝙞𝙘𝙬𝙖𝙮

This year, more than 4,000 people from around the world will come together for two amazing days. Experience the latest tech innovation, get insights into the Nordic startup and tech scene, and more: 

 ✔ 2 days
 ✔ 150+ speakers
 ✔ 30+ workshops
 ✔ 4,000+ attendees
 ✔ 2,500+ startups
 ✔ 600+ investors

Ticket sales are now open:
https://techbbq.dk/tickets/

💬 Catch talks from previous TechBBQ events right here:
http://bit.ly/2HuqJSM

𝗔𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝗧𝗘𝗖𝗛𝗕𝗕𝗤
TechBBQ is a non-profit organisation created by the community and for the community with the goal of supporting and accelerating the Nordic tech startup ecosystem. 

𝘞𝘦 𝘢𝘳𝘦 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘱𝘶𝘭𝘴𝘦 𝘰𝘧 𝘪𝘯𝘯𝘰𝘷𝘢𝘵𝘪𝘰𝘯 𝘢𝘯𝘥 𝘵𝘦𝘤𝘩𝘯𝘰𝘭𝘰𝘨𝘺 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘕𝘰𝘳𝘥𝘪𝘤𝘴. 

🚀 TechBBQ 2021 🚀
September 16-17
Øksnehallen, Copenhagen

Dates:
Thursday 16-09-2021 and Friday 17-09-2021
Location:
Øksnehallen | Halmtorvet 11, 1700 Copenhagen
Program (both days):
Check-in opens: 9:00 CEST
Stage program starts: 10:00 CEST
Stage program ends: 17:00 CEST
Doors close: 18:00 CEST


COVID-19:
Your safety is of the utmost importance, and TechBBQ is following all of the Danish government’s guidelines for COVID-19 as applicable to this event type. 

For this reason, you are required to show a valid coronapas (corona passport) or other legitimate documentation at the check-in area before entering the venue.

Legitimate documentation includes:

- Vaccination
- Negative test result
- Documentation of COVID-19 recovery

Failure to show a valid coronapas or other legitimate documentation will mean your access to the event will be declined. Any updates in regards to new Government guidelines will be communicated prior to the event.

Join us in September and let's push things forward 🚀 #THENORDICWAY
